edits.hypothesis: Instructing the policy to explicitly verify output files before declaring task complete reduces premature completions on tasks like bn-fit-modify.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prose guidance is the correct lever to explicitly remind the policy to perform final verification checks before signaling completion.

retroactive_check.corrective: On bn-fit-modify, the agent stopped at step 65 without running the sampling code; reminding it to verify required artifacts would have prompted it to execute the remaining commands.
retroactive_check.preservative: Does not disrupt successful trial loops since agents that already produce artifacts naturally benefit from checking them.
retroactive_check.transfer: Generalizes to any coding/data task where an agent might stop prematurely before generating final required files.

edits.regression_risk: Slight risk of adding an extra turn of verification on simple tasks.
